corpus.definition: Same fixed raw100k metadata and independent exhaustive chemistry oracles. Filters applied independently to complete oracle hits; no approximate shortlist. Empty intersection uses two existing mutually exclusive IDs.

instrumentation_interpretation: Ratios combine instrumentation effects with sequential run-to-run variation. Some instrumented batches are faster; this is not negative instrumentation cost. Do not subtract ratios from stage clocks or treat them as a precise overhead correction.
memory_warning: Process RSS/PSS shared peaks cannot be summed with owned logical capacities or across nonconcurrent runs.
publication_scope: Eager query-cost baseline only; no candidate-first/ANN timing. Numeric fields unchanged; process IDs and malformed memory-address keys removed from boundary snapshots.

runs.cache_condition: Result and predicate caches disabled. Shared OS cache not dropped. Two explicit unfiltered column/chemistry warmups precede loaded idle; restarted is not OS-cold.

logical_capacity.meaning: Observed Rust score-vector/decode-buffer capacity only; not full allocation ownership, usable allocation size or RSS. Peaks over one process lifetime, not per-case and not additive.

scope: One fresh process per variant; repeated warm execution requests with result/predicate caches disabled. Pilot/excluded runs omitted. No held-out/concurrent/candidate-first results in this file.
stage_warning: Nested stage scopes are exclusive thread CPU, not elapsed span duration. Stage13 mixes collection/shared query work. Boundaries include drain idle; reconciliation uses explicit sampling bounds.
